related.title: Java HashMap：負載因子與碰撞鏈
related.titleEn: Java HashMap: load factors and collisions
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付search-trace.csv與線性oracle比對；比較次數上界只適用此迴圈。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver search-trace.csv and a linear oracle comparison; the count bound applies to this loop. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 列key、hash、bucket、equals結果，對碰撞鍵逐一查找；表格不模擬Java樹化實作。
related.differenceEn: Tabulate key, hash, bucket and equality, checking colliding keys individually; the table does not emulate Java treeification.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
lower_bound找第一個不小於target的位置，需要資料滿足相對predicate的分割前提；重複鍵不應任意回中間一個。
本課數值核對：floor(log2(8))+1 = 4 comparison_bound；另一項核對：4-1 = 3 index_gap。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

hash表以hash選bucket但仍需equals分辨碰撞；負載因子不是每bucket長度，也不是所有hash分布都均勻。
本課數值核對：6/8 = 0.75 load_factor；另一項核對：6/16 = 0.375 load_factor。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
lower_bound locates the first position not less than the target under a partitioning precondition; duplicates should not yield an arbitrary matching position.
Numeric audit: floor(log2(8))+1 = 4 comparison_bound; second audit: 4-1 = 3 index_gap. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

A hash chooses a bucket but equality resolves collisions; load factor is not each bucket’s length, and hashes need not distribute uniformly.
Numeric audit: 6/8 = 0.75 load_factor; second audit: 6/16 = 0.375 load_factor. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Unicode 字素叢集：emoji 與游標邊界
related.titleEn: Unicode grapheme clusters: emoji and cursor boundaries
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付search-trace.csv與線性oracle比對；比較次數上界只適用此迴圈。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver search-trace.csv and a linear oracle comparison; the count bound applies to this loop. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 列碼點、ZWJ與預期字素範圍；清楚區分本fixture標註和完整UAX29演算法。
related.differenceEn: List code points, ZWJs and the expected grapheme span, distinguishing this annotated fixture from a full UAX29 implementation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
lower_bound找第一個不小於target的位置，需要資料滿足相對predicate的分割前提；重複鍵不應任意回中間一個。
本課數值核對：floor(log2(8))+1 = 4 comparison_bound；另一項核對：4-1 = 3 index_gap。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

延伸字素叢集是文字編輯的一種近似使用者字元邊界；emoji序列可跨多碼點，不能用單一碼點切片當通用游標步進。
本課數值核對：4+3 = 7 code_points；另一項核對：4*4+3*3 = 25 B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
lower_bound locates the first position not less than the target under a partitioning precondition; duplicates should not yield an arbitrary matching position.
Numeric audit: floor(log2(8))+1 = 4 comparison_bound; second audit: 4-1 = 3 index_gap. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Extended grapheme clusters approximate user-facing editing boundaries; emoji sequences can span code points, so one-code-point slicing is not a universal cursor step.
Numeric audit: 4+3 = 7 code_points; second audit: 4*4+3*3 = 25 B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
